**Daily Devotional**

**June 29**

*16 For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day. 17 For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory; (2 Corinthians 4:16-17 KJV)*

Paul was saying that although his body was perishing daily due to his persecution, because he had Christ living within him he was renewed daily by the very Spirit of Christ. All Christians should be able to draw on the power of Christ living within us, and be able to be renewed in strength although our bodies are failing. Our Spirits are created truly holy and righteous when we are born again (Ephesians 4:24), and we need to draw upon the power of God that lives within us, to give us the strength we need to persevere in this life. Jesus came to give us life more abundantly in this life (John 10:10).

The reason Paul could say his afflictions were only light was because of what he kept his mind on. If his afflictions were light, then ours are really light, as he was persecuted more than almost anyone in the bible, and he yet could call them light, as he kept his mind on the goal ahead of him (Philippians 3:14), and not on the problems he was experiencing. Whatever we focus our mind upon becomes magnified, and if we keep our mind on our problems, then they will become really big, but if you keep your mind on God, and what lies ahead of us (Heaven), then your problems will shrink in comparison (Isaiah 26:3). Learn this great lesson from Paul, and focus on the good things in this world, and that lay ahead of all us Christians. Praise God for our salvation.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
